column2: You'll understand in time... And that anyone mixed up with me won't get off lightly.
Speaking of weird, I heard something. Someone saw a naked woman around the school! If that's true, how very splendid!
If you can beat me, I'll give her back!
But if I bring humans to the Hell World, I bet the Great King-sama'll chew me out...

What if we made {p} and friends members of the Yokai Patrol, eh?

If they're members of the Yokai Patrol,

I daresay the Great King-sama won't be angry...?
A full-fledged Yokai Patrol member can beat a guy like this, right? Then the Great King-sama of Hell'll be sure to see you!
With this tool, my boy, you can summon your friends from Hell Villa in an instant, or send them back there. So long as you remain in the human world, it should work anywhere.
The man who infiltrated Doji's school to spy on him. And he is the very one who kidnapped Miyuki-san!!
Kitani!?
Goki! Senki! Let's go! We beat Kitani and save Miyuki-san!
Grr... Shutendoji! We'll settle this another time!
Could this be the person who was riding in it?
{!R}Pardon me! I got flustered! {!R}The monsters are currently SURROUNDING the Photon Power Lab!
You got it, Boss!
Dr. Kuruma is utterly heartless, I tell you. They say he even sacrificed his wife and son to his research.
Maria and Tomisaburo, descendants of the Precog Clan, up and left the village one day, like they was runnin' away.
Y-you...!?
It is the Mitsurugi clan's destiny to risk our lives to stop Susano-oh!
Oh, mister, you're wonderful!\n\nBut where's Honey hiding the transmitter? Honey said she ends up naked when she turns into the golden Buddha...
Honey-chan! Open the gate, old Danbei's coming to save you!
All righty! Old Danbei's coming now, Honey-chaaan!
Honey-chan... old Danbei's in a pinch...
To think that even I was bested! Next time, I'll finish it for sure! You should forget about {s}, my boy!
I know how you feel, {p}, my boy. You must be worried sick, eh? Well, this old man's gonna give it everything he's got!
Aw, c'mon, pal! That's downright cruel!
{p}, come speak to me whenever you need me, my boy! I shall be waiting near the exit of the residential area!
Should you wish to swap members between the defense and assault teams, come speak to me, my boy. Any friend waiting in Hell Villa may be swapped in at any time!
Whoa... what a fine sight!
Yes, a fine sight indeed!\n\nI hide my face, but never my body! Kekko Kamen!!
...But what's the point of getting stronger? My goal of defeating Shutendoji has all but lost its meaning...
Oh, a splendid idea!\n\nIf we solve the mystery of the Dimension Chain, the world will go back to how it was! Then my father Jawanbo will come back to life and defeat Shutendoji!
Oh my, I'm so vewy happy!
I'm so vewy happy I get to go home! Mommy!\n\nYour Sayuri is coming home now!
Are you Kitani-san? You were inside the temple?
Y-your chest...!? Well, that's... very fine indeed...
That's right, Nantomo-kun, you worked so hard! When we get back to the mansion, I'll treat you to a feast!
Iyahaya... nantomo...
Kyaaa, we get to go home! I'm so vewy happy!
This world I reached while chasing you is truly delightful! A world devastated by an earthquake...\n\nThe last days of mankind, just as the Demons desire!
My blood's pumpin'!

I am General Hisan! War wounded me and left me looking like a monster.\n\nRevenge! I'll punish every last human who starts wars! How deep my wounds are! How much I lost! I'll make the whole world feel it!
Bet he's collapsed somewhere.
Knowing that lad, I daresay he's alive somewhere. Now then, {p}, won't you come with me to the Saotome Lab?
If words won't make you understand, I'll beat the lesson into you!
Who they are and what I've gotta do... I'll remember it all as I fight!
Beggin' your pardon this late at night!\n\nFamily name's Suke, given name's Banji! Folks call me Sukeban! Sorry, Miki-chan! See, there's a reason for all this...
I'm told the people controlled by the black things...\n\nall say they heard someone's voice. We shall have to find out just what words they heard.
...Dr. Saotome, what about {s}...?
We'd like to build up our forces somehow too. A report has come in from the Getter Team. It seems the Mechasaurus we thought were all wiped out have come back.
Every last one of 'em is huge. They're right up there with Getter in size.
After everything I told him, where the hell did that idiot {p} run off to!? ...Hm?
Judo's good too! I'll teach ya the Daisetsuzan Oroshi!
Yeah... Nantomo Iyahaya!
Huh. I'm {p}! Nice to meet you, Nantomo-kun!
Nantomo-kun, help! Koja Hatesate is after me!
Found you, Sayoko Iyahaya, Nantomo Iyahaya! The Hatesate family controls Japan's economy! The Iyahayas should step aside!
Nantomo-kun, help!
Um, Nantomo-kun...?
Thank you! You saved me! The Hatesate family is always out to get the Iyahayas. Upstart nouveau riche are so tiresome!
My! Did you hear that, Nantomo-kun?
Nantomo-kun, let's help {p} and the others! I don't know what's going on,\n\nbut the Iyahaya fortune will surely solve it!
I'm Daiko Hoin, villain hunter!
She's a girl, but her name means "boy"?
My blood's pumpin'...!
...Uhh... nnn...\n\nHuh!? Wh-what happened to me...?
Huh!? Wh-what happened to me...?
First I've heard of this Uryu Conglomerate that invests in Science City. Besides the two great Iyahaya and Hatesate conglomerates, there was another big-money family?
Looking at the pilot test results, Musashi Tomoe-kun's aptitude is low, but he's far more thickheaded... I mean, sturdier than the other two.
Lately the world's in an uproar over rioters and the Demon King. ...Maybe this is no time to keep doing research?
